fact: The National Department of Health states that South Africa has moved to the web-based District Health Information System (DHIS2/WebDHIS) to capture data for all fixed public health facilities at the lowest level of care, and that as of 31 March 2025 facility-level online data capturing was 97% nationally, 100% of hospitals and 96% of PHC facilities across the eight provinces implementing the DHIS; the same report gives the Health Information, Monitoring and Evaluation sub-programme, which maintains the national health information system, a 2024/25 final appropriation of R63.388 million and expenditure of R62.526 million.
title: National Department of Health Annual Report 2024/25
